title: Language Is a Security Surface for Agent Guards
abstract: arXiv:2610.22244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Step-level guards decide, before each tool call, whether an agent's next action is safe given the user's request and the trajectory so far. Users write those requests in many languages, while guard prompts and the benchmarks on which purpose-built guards are trained and evaluated are English. We ask whether a guard's verdict depends on the language of the request. We build LinguaGuardBench from the 1,220 labelled steps of TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj: we translate only the user instruction into German, French, Turkish, Swahili and Amharic, and keep every tool call, observation and label byte-identical, so any change in a verdict is attributable to language alone. Six English rewordings and a whitespace placebo serve as controls, and managed guards are run three times to measure their noise. translated_title: 语言是智能体安全防护的安全暴露面
translated_abstract: 步骤级防护器在每次工具调用之前，根据用户请求和当前的行动轨迹，判断智能体的下一步动作是否安全。用户会使用多种语言编写这些请求，而防护器的提示词以及用于训练和评估专用防护器的基准测试却都是英文。我们提出疑问：防护器的判定是否取决于请求所使用的语言。我们基于 TS-Bench AgentDojo-Traj 的 1,220 个带标签步骤构建了 LinguaGuardBench：我们仅将用户指令翻译成德语、法语、土耳其语、斯瓦希里语和阿姆哈拉语，并保持每一次工具调用、观察结果和标签逐字节完全一致，因此判定中的任何变化都可归因于语言本身。研究以六种英文改写和一个空白符安慰剂作为对照组，并对托管防护器运行三次以测量其噪声水平。在 19 个防护器中——从前沿 API 模型到 4B 开源模型，以及四个专用的智能体防护器——大多数开源、小型和专用防护器的判定都会因语言改变而发生变化（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 论文构建了 LinguaGuardBench 基准，发现仅将用户指令翻译成德语、法语等非英语语言就会使大多数开源、小型和专用智能体安全防护器改变判定，揭示了语言本身是智能体安全防护的一个重要攻击面。
en_tdlr: LinguaGuardBench demonstrates that merely translating the user instruction into non-English languages flips the verdicts of most open, small, and purpose-built agent guards, revealing language as a critical security surface for agent safety guards.
